purpose: Cached static contract for Fallen Doll H-system research before runtime experiments
researchRules: Consult this contract and unpacked indexes before any game experiment.
Runtime discovery is limited to dynamic visibility, unlock state, and active instances that static assets cannot determine.
Do not perform broad per-frame object enumeration.
If a bounded runtime discovery finds a new class, property, or function relationship, update this contract before the next experiment.
